title: Headless TTW Aiding the Outcasts (DLC02OA1): from the Outcast distress signal through Defender Morrill's fight at the outpost, Protector McGraw's offer, Olin's Neural Interface suit and the simulation pod to Sergeant Montgomery's briefing inside the Anchorage simulation (stage 200, quest completed)

actions.text: Starts with the player out of Vault 101 (the given): Escape! (CG04) done at stage 200, whose script starts Following in His Footsteps (MQ01 stage 10) and Trouble on the Homefront (MS16). [observed: CG04 stage 200 script]

The add-on's trigger: DLC02OA1 is start-game enabled and DLC02OA1QuestScript [observed] starts the Outcast signal 60 seconds after the Enclave Radio station (RadioEnclaveREF) is enabled, or once MQ09 reaches 60. Stand-in for the main quest turning Enclave Radio on: the station is enabled here; the quest script then enables DLC02OutcastRadioSignalREF and sets DLC02OA1 10 (Investigate the Outcast Radio Signal, with the add-on's start message).

Travel stand-in: following the signal to the ruins by the Outcast outpost, where Defender Morrill is pinned down by super mutants. His force-greet (DLC02MorrillForcegreet, the line for a player not in Outcast power armor) sets stage 15 and opens his cage.

Stand-in for the fight through the ruins to the outpost: the player kills two of the intro super mutants (DLC02DefenderMorrillScript [observed] sets PlayerHelped when one of them names the player its killer).

actions.label: morrill: mind explaining what you're doing here
it looked like you needed help
milestone: DLC02OA1 20, speak with the Outcast leader

actions.text: Travel stand-in: the elevator down into the Outcast base (DLC02VSS01). Defender Sibley meets the player and leads them to Protector McGraw.

actions.label: sibley: keep your weapons holstered, follow me
mcgraw: so you're the one Morrill sent down
guilty as charged, but you need help

actions.text: Travel stand-in: following Sibley to the simulator room. Specialist Olin hands over the Neural Interface suit (his greeting's end script: the suit, stage 45).

actions.label: olin: put this on and get in the chair (stage 45)
milestone: DLC02OA1 45, put on the suit

actions.text: Engine gap (as in ttw-mq04-tranquility-lane): DLC02SimChairScript waits for GetSitting 3 beside DLC02SimChairREF and the headless runner has no step that seats the player. Stand-in for the player sitting in the pod: what that script's sitting block does [observed] (StartQuest DLC02OA2, OA2GetUpGo 1, OA1AnimSetup 1, PlayerInChair 1); its own timer then sets PlayerInChair 2 and DLC02OA1QuestScript swaps the player's gear for the simulation's and moves the player to DLC02SimulationStart.

Inside the simulation: DLC02OA2QuestScript [observed] gives the player a waking package near Sergeant Montgomery and, 9 seconds on, has him start his briefing (DLC02OA2MontTalk01, 03, 04, 06, 07, each SayToDone starting the next; the last sets DLC02OA1 200 and shows OA2's first objective).

actions.label: The Guns of Anchorage: infiltrate the artillery site
